Marta: Two super-fast polls before lunch planning:
1) Lunch today? react with emoji or reply with the number.
   1: :sushi: Sushi
   2: :taco: Tacos
   3: :green_salad: Grain bowl
   4: :pizza: Pizza
2) Weekend mini-challenge editor pick for pair-programming (single-word replies welcome): VSCode / Neovim / Emacs / JetBrains

Drew: 2 + Neovim

Ivy: 1 and VSCode (i need my extensions)

Harold: 4 and Emacs (old habits)

Zoe: 3 + JetBrains if we're doing java, otherwise Neovim

Marta: also accepting write-ins — someone suggested "Sando" (sandwich).

Drew: write-in for editor: "Lite" (for when you just want to stare at a file)

poll-bot: Polls closed after 20m. Results:
Lunch: Sushi 1, Tacos 1, Grain bowl 1, Pizza 1, Write-ins: Sando 1 (note: write-ins counted separately)
Editor: VSCode 1, Neovim 2, Emacs 1, JetBrains 1, Write-ins: Lite 1

Marta: wow tie across the board for lunch. looks like well do a mixed order. will post a signup with portions.

Ivy: mixed order sounds perfect :heart_eyes:

Harold: Neovim win for the editor mini-challenge — Ill host a 45-min session Saturday to pair.

Zoe: saving snacks for Saturday then :popcorn:

Marta: thanks everyone, Ill DM for dietary prefs and put the pairing sesh on the calendar.
